description_original:
¹ Ṣawm - It is an abstention from specific actions such as eating, drinking, conjugal relations and so on, in the manner that has been mentioned between the predefined times of sunrise and sunset.
[Defined by Shaykh Zulfiker Ibrāhīm Memon حفظه الله]

² Recorded in Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Book of Ṣiyām, Section: The Obligation To Observe Sawm in Ramadan When The Crescent Is Sighted, And To Break The Sawm When The Crescent Is Sighted, And That If It Is Cloudy At The Beginning Or End Of The Month, Then The Month Should Be Completed As Thirty Days, Ḥadīth number 1081 [2514], Volume: 3, Page: 145, Printed by: Dārus-salām English Edition, Printed in: 1428AH/2007CE.

³ According to the Islamic calender the night belongs to the day that follows it. Thus, Shaykh (حفظه الله) says “Saturday's night” not “Friday's night”.

⁴ Recorded in Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim, Book of Ṣiyām, Section: Each Land Has Its Own Sighting Of The Moon, And If They See The Crescent In One Land, That Does Not Necessarily Apply To Regions That Are Far Away From It, Ḥadīth number 1087 [2528], Volume: 3, Page: 150-151, Printed by: Dārus-salām English Edition, Printed in: 1428AH/2007CE.

لا تنسوني من صالح دعائكم 
أسأل الله أن يشفي مريضنا ويشفي كل مريض
ودائما أقول: لا أنصح بالرقاة، اللهم إلا إذا كان الأمر ملحا، ونريد أن نأخذ معلومة أواستشارة من الثقة الأمين التقي، ويمكن للمريض أو أقاربه أن يرقوا أنفسهم؛ لأن المريض وأهله أكثر إخلاصا في رقيتهم، وبالذات في النساء، لأن الفتن شديدة، والقلوب ضعيفة، وبعض الرقاة -إلا من رحم ربي- يستضعفن النساء وميل قلوبهن فيدخلن لهن من مداخل ويجذبن بعضهن إذا رأى منهن ضعفا، ثم تكون الأمور غير المحمودة والعواقب الوخيمة.
والله من وراء القصد

What does Tawḥīd mean and who is a Muwaḥḥid?
🎙️ Ash-Shaykh Waṣīullāh ‘Abbās حفظه الله

#SharḥKitābatTawḥīdSeries By #ShaykhWaṣīullāhAbbās 

Follow official accounts of Shaykh Waṣīullāh bin Muḥammad ‘Abbās حفظه الله on social media :
http://linktr.ee/DrWasiullahAbbas

There was a tongue slip at 00:48, may Allāh preserve our Shaykh Waṣīullāh and regarding what shaykh said at 00:58 :
«ان اعبدوا الله ولا تشركوا به شيئا»
It maybe,
«وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُشْرِكُوا۟ بِهِۦ شَيئا»
[سورة النساء، آية ٣٦]
As later shaykh explained this āyah, but we can't say this with 100% certainity so I have edited what shaykh said, والله أعلم.

بارك الله فيكم.

description_original:
What is the Shar‘ī ruling on using the term, ‘Ahlul Ḥadīth (People of Ḥadīth)’?
[Benefit number 2]

Transcription :
What is the Shar‘ī ruling on using the term, ‘Ahlul Ḥadīth (People of Ḥadīth)’? Someone could ask that Allāh Rabbul ‘Izzat Has generally named us Muslims in the Qur’ān :
 هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ 
“He (Allāh) named you as Muslims” 
[Sūrah al-ḥajj (22) : Āyah 78]
So then, why should we name ourselves Ahlul Ḥadīth? 

The reason is; a Muslim could either be from Ahlul-Ḥadīth or from other than Ahlul-Ḥadīth. Thus, when differing occurred in the ’ummah, some people named themselves with different types of names, 

whereas those people who were following the true dīn, i.e. those who followed the perfect dīn (with no heresies) of prophet's ﷺ time and who tried (their best) to keep it alive (by practising and spreading it) used the term Ahlul Ḥadīth (to differentiate themselves from those who deviated from the truth). 

The others were initially called ‘Ahlul rā’i (People of Analogy)’ and these were the people who left the original path of dīn and chose the other (deviated) way, thus there was a need to name (and differentiate) oneself with this term. Yes.

بارك الله فيكم.
-
#AhlulHadith are the saved sect
by #ShaykhWasiullahAbbas حفظه الله

description_original:
Activate the subtitles for the translation.

Transcription :
(the Arabs) before Islām used to kill and rob each other (i.e. oppress). Trust was vanished. But as a result of acting upon Qur’ān and Sunnah they became brothers to one another, alḥamdulillāh. 

As Allāh Says,
وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ كُنتُمْ أَعْدَآءً فَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِكُمْ
“and remember Allāh’s Favour on you, for you were enemies one to another but He joined your hearts together (and made you brothers)”
[Sūrah ‘Ālī ‘Imrān (3) : 103]

Allāh United (the ṣaḥābah) through this dīn. Everyone came together and believed in one dīn, one rasūl and One Allāh. Till many days this was the situation of islām. Later on, (deviated) groups and sects occurred and kept their names.

However, alḥamdulillāh the Ahlul-Ḥadīth who were in the time of Beloved messenger ﷺ i.e. all the ṣaḥābah (such as) Abū Bakr, ‘Umar, ‘Uthmān, ‘Alī (رضي الله عنهم) etc, and then the Tāba‘īn and at-bā at-Tāba‘īn remained upon the perfect dīn of Prophet ﷺ, which was cultivated upon following the Qur’ān and the Sunnah and they became known as the Ahlul-Ḥadīth. 
بارك الله فيكم.
-
#AhlulHadith are the saved sect by #ShaykhWasiullahAbbas حفظه الله

description_original:
When Shaykh Waṣīullāh ‘Abbās حفظه الله visited the UK in 1435 A.H. corresponding to 2014, a lot of people have been propagating lies such as, Ahlul Ḥadīth don't have a Madhhab, they don't have principles from which they derive or deduce the rulings and there are only four Madhāhib.

One of the heads of the ikhwānīs of The UK pretended to be a student of Shaykh Bin Bāz رحمه الله and has been attacking Shaykh al-Albānī رحمه الله for many years, saying, Shaykh Nāṣir ud-dīn al-Albānī just knew how to verify a Ḥadīth, he wasn't a Faqīh and thus had no knowledge of Fiqh.

This type of notion was being spread at that time and to the way from Leicester to Luton, Shaykh Dhulfiqār discussed this issue in detail with Shaykh Waṣīullāh ‘Abbās حفظهما الله and brought forth their arguments and a lengthy discussion took place.

And then Shaykh Waṣīullāh ‘Abbās حفظه الله said that that day he would address these issues so that the people know that Ahlul Ḥadīth are ancient, they have a Madhhab and alḥamdulillāh this Madhhab is present from day one. 

[So that the people know that] The Madhhab of Ahlul Ḥadīth has its own principles and they are firm upon their ‘Aqīdah and Fiqh. They are not fanatics of anyone.

[So that the people know that] Ahlul Ḥadīth do not do Taqlīd of anyone, rather they do the Ittebā‘ of Muṣṭafā Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ and they respect the scholars for their efforts and in this Madhhab every single man's statement is accepted or rejected,
بارك الله فيكم.

¹ as-Sawm - It is an abstention from specific actions such as eating, drinking, conjugal relations and so on, in the manner that has been mentioned between the predefined times of sunrise and sunset.
[Defined by Shaykh Zulfiker Ibrahim Memon حفظه الله]

² al-Muttaqun - The pious believers of Islamic Monotheism who fear Allah much (abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which He has forbidden) and love Allah much (perform all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained).

description_original:
The group that remained upon the original way of following the Qur’ān and the Sunnah became known as the Ahlul-Ḥadīth. 
[Benefit number 3]

Transcription :
When the Prophet ﷺ was sent, the environment or the situation (of the Arabs) was that they did not follow any specific religion and they used to deny (The Existence of) Allāh as is well known among the world. Some people used to believe in the hereafter, whereas some disbelieved. 

There were different types of (ignorant) people; though worshipping idols was common in everyone. Allāh Has Portrayed them in this āyah itself :
«هُوَ ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ (رَسُولًا)»
“It is He who sent among the ‘unlettered’, a messenger” 
When the Prophet ﷺ was sent down to Makkah, only four people knew how to read and write; so they were an ‘unlettered’ people.

So, among the ‘unlettered’ people, a Dhāt, a Rasūl was sent (by Allāh), who taught them («ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ «وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ) the book of Allāh and his Sunnah; which is equivalent to the word ‘ḥikmah’ (which comes in the aforementioned āyah).

Through the book of Allāh and the Sunnah, he (ﷺ) directed them to the (path of) guidance, before (his arrival) people were upon clear misguidance :
«وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ»
“And verily, they had been before in manifest error” 
[Sūrah Jumu’ah (62) : 2]

[This āyah shows that] the way out of their misguidance was the arrival of Prophet ﷺ i.e. [1] The Kitāb of Allāh and [2] the Sunnah of Rasūlullāh ﷺ , upon which the ṣaḥābah acted.

بارك الله فيكم.
-
#AhlulHadith are the saved sect
by #ShaykhWasiullahAbbas حفظه الله

description_original:
Summary for English speakers :

Question :
Which type of heretics shouldn't be given salām?

Answer :
Firstly know that, any invented matter in the dīn of Allāh which is not proven from the Rasūlullāh ﷺ, from his Ṣaḥābah and the Rightly Guided caliphs is known as Bid‘ah.

And there is no Bid‘ah ḥasanah (good bid‘ah), as Rasūlullāh ﷺ said :
كل بدعة ضلالة وكل ضلالة في النار
Every newly invented matter (in the dīn) is an error and every error is in hellfire.

There are 2 types of Bid‘ah :
1] The bid‘ah which leads to kufr -
Examples : 
-Believing in Waḥdatul Wujūd, 
-The bid‘ah of Rāfiḍah which is to believe that ‘Alī disappeared from the world and when he returns, non-shi‘ās will kill him,
-The bid‘ah of Qāḍiyānīs which is to believe that a prophet will come after Nabī Muḥammad ﷺ.

It's obligatory not to give salām to such a person whose bid‘ah leads to kufr.

2] The bid‘ah which doesn't leads to kufr but is an error (less than kufr)
Examples :
-Giving adhān for ‘Īd prayer 
-Doing 2 sujūd after taslīm 
-Shaking hands after praying Ṣalāh

If you disassociate yourself from the person and there are chances that the person will stop doing the bid‘ah, then it's obligatory upon you to disassociate yourself.
Example - Your children aren't praying Ṣalāh, if you disassociate yourself from them, then they will start praying Ṣalāh, but if your neighbors disassociate themselves from them (the children), then the disassociating of neighbors will have no impact on them.
So here, disassociating yourself from the person is obligatory upon you! (And not upon the neighbors)

But if you were to disassociate from the person and there are no chances that the person will stop doing the bid‘ah then disassociating is not permissible rather you should advise him.

Dalīl (evidence) :
When Abdullāh ibn ‘umar mentioned the Ḥadīth of Rasūlullāh ﷺ about, not stoping the women to go to the masājid, Bilāl the son of Abdullāh Ibn ‘Umar said, “I will definitely stop them, perhaps they may get a chance to misuse it”

Abdullāh Ibn ‘Umar said, “I'm mentioning the Ḥadīth of Rasūlullāh ﷺ to you & you are saying to oppose it!”

So it's narrated, that Abdullāh ibn ‘umar didn't talk to him until he died.

description_original:
The meaning of ‘Ahlul Ḥadīth’
[Benefit number 1]

Transcription :
Ahlul-Ḥadīth consists of two words; ‘Ahl’ and ‘Ḥadīth’. ‘Ahl’ means «people of» and ‘Ḥadīth’ can include the meaning of «the Qur’ān». 

It is also actions, statements, taqrīr (approvals) and awṣāf (characteristics-appearance and manners) authentically transmitted from the Prophet ﷺ. 

An example of the taqrīrāt (approvals) is, when a ṣaḥābi does an action in front of the Prophet ﷺ, and the Prophet ﷺ did not do inkār (stop them from doing that action). 

This is also equivalent to the shari‘ah as a whole. Thus Allāh said, 
{لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ}
“Indeed in the Messenger of Allāh (Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) you have a good example to follow”
[Sūrah Al-Aḥzāb (33) : Āyah 21]

بارك الله فيكم.
-
#AhlulHadith are the saved sect
by #ShaykhWasiullahAbbas حفظه الله

description_original:
In this video Shaykh (حفظه الله) speaks about:
-Saying ṣawm is unbearable 
-The purpose of observing ṣawm

Footnotes 
¹ Aṣ-Ṣawm - It is an abstention from specific actions such as eating, drinking, conjugal relations and so on, in the manner that has been mentioned between the predefined times of sunrise and sunset.
[Defined by Shaykh Zulfiker Ibrāhīm Memon حفظه الله]

² Al-Muttaqūn - The pious believers of Islamic Monotheism who fear Allāh much (abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which He has forbidden) and love Allāh much (perform all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained).
[Defined by Dr Muḥsin Khān and Shaykh Taqī-ud-Dīn al-Hilālī رحمهما الله]
